summaries.body: The mapping records V6.5.1 as MODIFIED, MOVED FROM v4.0.3-2.6.1, MERGED FROM v4.0.3-2.8.4, SPLIT FROM v4.0.3-2.7.3, COVERS v4.0.3-2.2.6. V2.6.1: lookup secrets usable only once. V2.8.4: time-based OTP usable only once within the validity period. V2.7.3: out-of-band requests, codes, or tokens usable once and only for the original request. V2.2.6: replay resistance via OTP devices, cryptographic authenticators, or lookup codes. On 4 November 2018 vanderaj reworked out-of-band verifier requirements (134fc631), including the V2.7.3 once-only rule.

5.0 concatenates the three once-only rules into a single sentence covering lookup secrets, out-of-band requests or codes, and TOTPs. Binding to the original OOB request moved to V6.6.2; replay-resistance coverage of V2.2.6 is implicit in once-only use. work's #499 typo fix ("seperated" in 2.2.6) and tghosth's formatting on V2.8.4 are not policy. Jim's 22 February 2019 Cryptography.md update labelled V6.5.1, and vanderaj removing company names from V2.2.6, are other-slot or adjacent-slot events — not the 5.0 merge wording.
